title: Frontend security gate (eslint-security + audit)
summary: Runs eslint (with the security plugin if present) and a dependency audit against the frontend.
notes: Primary value is the eslint-security gate (net-new vs agentsec). The dependency-audit step is a convenience: `agentsec audit` already runs node-audit (npm/pnpm) via its node_audit runner, so if your agentsec CI run already runs it (node-audit needs `--network tier1`) you can drop the audit step here. Adapts to your detected package manager (npm/pnpm/bun).
